Thank you for sharing that. To help narrow this down, do you have a history of tobacco smoking, and if so, approximately how many pack-years?
I smoke cigarettes. I’m also a former smoker, and I’m exposed to secondhand cigarette smoke on a daily basis. I don’t know my approximate pack-years.

I don’t know.

I don’t know.
